card.name: Rapidly before an effect or change
card.fires_on: The word "rapidly" (or "fast", or "RAPIDLY" split into pieces) used as an adverb right before an adjective or verb describing how quickly something changes or proceeds. Mostly seen in drug-label statements about reversibility, tumor growth or effects on the body.

modes.label: Rapidly before an adjective
modes.description: "Rapidly" modifies an adjective describing a condition or tumor, such as reversible or proliferative.
modes.example: Patients with high tumor burden and<< rapidly>> proliferative tumor may be at increased risk

modes.label: Rapidly before a verb or as speed word
modes.description: "Rapidly", "fast" or the ending of RAPIDLY describes how quickly an effect occurs or something is needed.
modes.example: The administration of exogenous surfactants, including INFASURF, can<< rapidly>> affect oxygenation and lung compliance.

card.plain: It marks the word "rapidly" when it describes how quickly a change, effect or process happens.
